role: SCENE PLATE / SET / LIGHTING & GRADE MASTER
asset_note: media_id 80f16ecd-9086-4bbc-97c8-ab71caf83e62. Original is a beauty-brand still life (EADEM). Only the SET is retained. All original products and all typography are to be deleted.
scene_type: Studio tabletop still life — levitating-product editorial, seamless backdrop, no human model, no hands, no environment beyond the sweep

background.type: seamless paper sweep, no visible horizon line, no floor/wall seam
background.gradient: soft radial luminance pool centred slightly above and behind the object cluster, falling off ~1.6 stops into all four corners
background.texture: matte, near-zero specularity, faint paper tooth visible only at 100%, no gloss, no reflection of the products
background.vignette: optical + lighting-driven, smooth, no hard-edged post vignette

set_dressing.primary_element: stacked hardcover books, closed, forming an irregular stepped plinth
set_dressing.count: 6–8 volumes across two offset stacks (a taller 4–5 book main stack lower-left/centre, a shorter 2–3 book secondary stack behind-right)
set_dressing.orientation: page-blocks (fore-edges) facing camera on most volumes, spines turned away or angled out of frame — so no legible titles
set_dressing.rotation: each book rotated 4–12° off the one beneath it, creating a loose hand-stacked look, not machine-aligned
set_dressing.page_block: ivory to warm bone (#EFE6D6 → #DCCDB4), visibly layered leaf edges, micro-shadow between leaves, slight cockling and age-toning at the corners
set_dressing.material_detail: cloth-bound and matte board covers, softly worn corners, no dust jackets, no barcodes, no publisher marks, no legible lettering anywhere

products: cream/ivory pump bottle resting on the lower book
dark burgundy squeeze tube levitating upper-right
small silver metallic lip tube levitating centre-left
sage-green cylindrical mist bottle standing right
typography: bottom line: 'THE NEW CLASSICS —— EVERYDAY SKIN + LIP ICONS'
objects_and_text_to_REMOVE.branding: every occurrence of the EADEM wordmark on every product
objects_and_text_to_REMOVE.cleanup_rule: Rebuild the bordeaux sweep and the book surfaces underneath every removed object, including the contact shadows and reflected bounce those objects were casting. No ghosting, no smudged patches, no cloned-texture repetition, no residual letterforms.

key.type: large soft source (interpret as 120x180cm softbox, double-diffused)
key.azimuth: upper front-left, roughly 40–50° off the lens axis
key.quality: broad and soft-edged; shadow penumbra roughly one third the height of the object casting it

fill.effect: opens the right-hand shadow sides without killing the modelling

ambient_bounce.effect: warm red-magenta spill wrapping the lower and rear faces of every object — critical for integration realism

lighting_read.overall_scheme: single-key, low-key-warm, controlled contrast; no hard sun, no coloured gels on the products

shadows.direction: cast down-and-right, away from the key
shadows.contact_shadow: tight, dark, high-density directly under every load-bearing edge (approx 92% opacity at the contact line)
shadows.cast_shadow: soft-edged, warm-toned (never neutral grey, never blue), density falling to ~25% within 1.5x the object height
shadows.levitation_shadow: floating objects cast a detached, larger, softer, lower-opacity shadow on the surface below them — this is the single strongest cue that sells the levitation
shadows.occlusion: deep ambient occlusion in the gaps between stacked books and in the leaf-edge striations

camera_read.aperture: f/9–f/11 — the full stack is sharp, the backdrop is soft but not bokeh-blobbed
camera_read.height: level with the middle of the main stack
camera_read.tilt: 1–4° down; essentially a straight-on product elevation, NOT a top-down or hero-low angle
camera_read.perspective: flat and product-honest, minimal converging verticals, no wide-angle stretch

colour_grade.palette: deep bordeaux ground + olive / mustard / cream / kraft accents
colour_grade.saturation: rich but restrained; reds are deep and dense rather than vivid
colour_grade.black_point: lifted very slightly, filmic — blacks read as dark maroon, not pure 0,0,0
colour_grade.highlight_rolloff: gentle, no clipped speculars except pinpoint glints

rendering_signature.realism: photographic, commercial catalogue grade — this must read as a shot, not a render
rendering_signature.grain: very fine luminance-only grain, ~2%, medium-format-film character
rendering_signature.blur: none on the subjects; only natural depth-of-field falloff on the backdrop
rendering_signature.distortion: none — no barrel, no pincushion, no fisheye
rendering_signature.chromatic_aberration: essentially none, a trace of warm fringing at extreme highlight edges only
rendering_signature.sharpening: moderate capture sharpening, no halos, no over-crisp edges
